messages:
claire: Noticed spikes of 429s during new-org onboarding. Sample app prefetches ~40 docs concurrently at boot and lots of clients hit refresh simultaneously.
oz: Is this only hosted or reproducible against staging?
claire: Repro on staging. Pattern: signup webhook -> client starts prefetch -> token refresh hits for some clients -> immediate retries -> spike.
ram: Sounds like two problems: uncontrolled prefetch concurrency + token-refresh race bypassing limiter.
claire: Exactly. Quick mitigation I tested: cap prefetch to 8 and add a 1s ramp between batches. 429s dropped from ~25% to ~2% in a 200-client sim.
oz: Nice. Longer-term we should add an SDK-level semaphore + refresh-join so refreshes are deduped and requests always acquire the limiter.
ram: Agree. API suggestions for parity: config keys max_inflight / ramp_ms / jitter_pct and a boolean refresh_join. Keep names identical across JS/Go/Py.
claire: Pseudocode for join pattern we discussed:
```js
// internal SDK pattern
if (!refreshPromise) { refreshPromise = doRefresh(); }
await refreshPromise; // waiters join here
await semaphore.acquire();
try { await sendReq() } finally { semaphore.release(); }
```

oz: Add jitter to ramp so many clients don't align on cold start. Also sample app should switch to on-demand for >50 seed docs.
ram: I'll prepare a small JS SDK PR implementing semaphore + refresh join and unit tests for concurrent refresh.
claire: I'll update sampleapp with concurrency cap 8 + 1000ms ramp + 30% jitter and add a tiny load harness (100 signups at t=0).
devex-bot: Created issue DEVEX-970: "prefetch throttling + token refresh join" https://redwood/devex/970
ci-bot: sampleapp/pr-421 created  tests passed :white_check_mark:
oz: After merges let's run a 200-org run in staging and aim for <1% 429s during startup window.
ram: Will add docs snippet showing how to tune max_inflight for server vs embedded environments.
claire: Thanks all. Monitoring tomorrow morning, will revert ramp if anything unexpected. :thumbsup:
